description: Soy Héctor Emmanuel Mercado Medina, estudio en el CONALEP Saltillo 1, se un poco de desarrollo web, programación, electrónica, y me gustaría poder trabajar con mis compañeros y participar en NASA space Apps Challenge.
summary:
Medical monitoring in space requires compact solutions that do not depend on a network connection. This project presents a wireless system for astronauts capable of capturing heart signals by a microsensor and transmitting data using a microcontroller. When in operation, the system displays the heart rate on an OLED and cpu display.

Our prototype use 2 microcontrollers “LoRa TTGO ESP32”. These will receive and transmit signals among themselves to monitor the cardiovascular status of the astronauts. If the heart rate exceeds 120 beats per minute(BPM), the base will be notified, and the data will be displayed on a graph shown on a screen. This will allow the astronaut to request assistance or take steps to prevent a cardiovascular issue.
details:
Our project uses radio signals to transmit the vital signs of the entire crew through space, utilizing the LoRa communication modules used in space projects such as LEO.

The sensor we use measures the heart’s bioelectric signals, which are processed through a Kalman filter to eliminate signal noise caused by the person’s movement and electronic devices. The signal is transmitted to the device at the lunar base, where, in the future, artificial intelligence will process the data and recommend physical activity or relaxation exercises based on the person’s heart rate.

This device could be used for geolocation via time-of-flight algorithms between different devices.
